title: What Did Nvidia’s Board Know, and When?
gist: Post summarizing a transcript on Nvidia's November 2026 leadership crisis: Jensen Huang's admitted infidelity, a board probe into possible foreign-intelligence targeting linked to a Mega Speed executive, and a report about healthcare VP Kimberly Powell that led to Huang's resignation; it questions what the board knew about a reported March hotel incident and when.

themes.theme: Sequence of the Nvidia leadership crisis

insights.claim: According to the transcript, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang acknowledged marital infidelity in an email to employees in November 2026 without identifying the other person.
insights.speaker: Xebec
insights.so_what: Key-person governance event at the most important AI chip company.

insights.claim: Nvidia's board initially backed Huang while commissioning an independent investigation into whether he had been targeted by a foreign intelligence operation, saying it had no reason to believe company secrets or national security were compromised.

insights.so_what: Board initially framed it as a security question, not a misconduct one.
